title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. translated_title: 面向长时程智能体强化学习的树感知后验蒸馏
translated_abstract: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习已成为大语言模型的一种可扩展的后训练范式。然而，在长时程交互中训练智能体面临两个挑战：仅使用终端奖励使得回合级别的信用分配稀疏且方差很高，而在固定的回放批次上进行顺序小批量更新会引入策略陈旧问题，因为当前策略会逐渐偏离行为策略。现有方法通过学习评论家、过程奖励模型或在线策略蒸馏来获得更密集的信用信号，但它们依赖于价值网络、步骤级标注或更强的外部教师模型，从而增加了训练复杂性。与此同时，重要性采样和裁剪可以缓解策略漂移，但它们并未指定一个有限的目标来阻止顺序更新过度。在这项工作中，我们提出了TreeOPSD，一个无评论家、树感知的后验自蒸馏框架，用于长时程智能体……
tldr: 本文提出TreeOPSD，一种无需评论家的树感知后验自蒸馏框架，通过将树结构回放批次转化为有限的后验自蒸馏目标，同时解决长时程智能体强化学习中的稀疏信用分配与策略陈旧问题。
en_tdlr: TreeOPSD is a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework that converts tree-structured rollout batches into a finite self-distillation target, jointly addressing sparse turn-level credit assignment and policy staleness in long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning.
